title: Template-token handshake: canonicalize tokenizer delimiters and onboard sanity checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: During onboarding of several open model bundles we observed template/role delimiter mismatches and off-by-one token deltas that caused prompt truncation or unexpected assistant role leakage at runtime. Root causes identified: tokenizer metadata (vocab/merges/normalization) not fingerprinted in the bundle manifest; chat template delimiter heuristics accept multiple variants but onboarding doesn't validate the canonicalized token stream; and performance profile publishing omits tokenizer delta metrics that would have surfaced large token-count regressions.

Proposal: 1) Add a tokenizer fingerprint and canonicalization manifest to model bundles so the runtime can deterministically apply the same normalization used during onboarding. 2) Introduce a "template-token handshake" stage in the onboarding pipeline that: (a) runs a small battery of golden prompts (system/user/assistant mixes) at 3 sequence lengths, (b) computes tokenization deltas vs Redwood canonical template expectations, (c) normalizes delimiter variants (unicode quotes, em dash, sparse whitespace) into the canonical envelope when safe, and (d) fails onboarding with an actionable report when deltas exceed thresholds. 3) Publish tokenizer-aware metrics in the model performance profile (token_delta_by_prompt, delimiter_mismatch_examples) so model pinning and perf-publish consumers can make informed rollouts. 4) Backfill existing published profiles for top-20 onboarded models with the new tokenizer metrics.

Implementation details: - onboarding/service/onboard_worker: add step compute_tokenizer_fingerprint(bundle) -> sha256 string saved in registry. - onboarding/harness: include template_token_handshake test harness using 48 golden prompts; fuzz 200 delimiter variants. - runtime: accept tokenizer_fingerprint in model manifest; throw a clear, instrumented mismatch log if runtime tokenizer differs. - console: add a line-item in model profile UI summarizing token_delta_percent and example mismatches. - docs: update onboarding checklist (Confluence link) and SDK note on prompt length accounting.

Acceptance criteria: - CI harness includes unit + fuzz tests and a small e2e that simulates pinning a model with a differing tokenizer; onboarding should fail with clear remediation steps. - New profile fields published for new onboarding runs. - Backfill job successfully publishes for top-20 models within 3 days of rollout. - Canary rollout to 10% of onboarding traffic with feature flag enabled, no customer-facing regressions for two weeks.

Metrics to monitor: - onboarding_failure_rate (should increase transiently then drop as manifests are corrected), - template_mismatch_incidents (target: 0 for new onboards), - avg_token_delta_percent (target: <2%).

Links & artifacts: - Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Tokenizer+Handshake+Design - Golden prompts sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GOLDENPROMPTS - Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/483 - Perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/models/onboard-metrics

Rollout plan: feature-flag gated rollout (flag: tokenizer_onboard_strict). Stage 1: internal dev env (done). Stage 2: canary at 10% (1 week), monitor metrics and rollback on regressions. Stage 3: 100% onboarding traffic and run backfill job. Post-rollout retrospective and create any follow-ups as separate tickets.
